headline: Congress renamed a federal building in Detroit, Michigan, the Rosa Parks Federal Building.
what_it_does: This law officially names the federal building at 985 Michigan Avenue in Detroit as the Rosa Parks Federal Building. It is a naming measure and does not change how the building is used or run. The official summary does not describe any other effects.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 22, 2024.
